summary: Frontend-only validation of the rewritten pedagogical bidding guidance in the tutorial teaching game. PASS on all 6 requested items. Two distinct new-benchmark messages were rendered on-screen (bid_pass_high and bid_contre), with zero unresolved placeholders ({n}/{value}/{suit}/{prev}/{card}/{name}). Learner freedom preserved — all bid controls that are legal in the game state remained enabled. After clicking Passer, the game advanced into the playing phase and the play-phase coach hint continued to work (pulsing gold card + bubble 'Le pli est perdu : fournis au plus bas (9♣).'). Regression confirmed: normal solo game (play-solo-card + match-type-short) shows NO coach-bubble.

evidence.auth: Fresh POST /api/auth/login returned a valid JWT; UI login as tester1@belote.tn also succeeded (→ /home).
evidence.tutorial_game_create: POST /api/tutorial/game (Bearer token) returned {game_id: g_12048d28c96f} in session A and {game_id: g_94470206bf80} in session B. Navigating to /game/{game_id} loaded the coach-enabled bidding table.
bidding_hint_messages_observed: bid_pass_high (FR): "L'enchère dépasse ce que ta main promet. Ne surenchéris pas sans vraie force : passe." (i18n.tsx L135)
bid_contre (FR): "Tu es fort dans leur atout : Contre !" (i18n.tsx L133)
evidence.placeholder_leak_check: Scanned every bubble text for {n}, {value}, {suit}, {prev}, {card}, {name} — 0 occurrences.

freedom_check_session_A.conclusion: Coach advice recommends passer but every legal action remains freely selectable.

evidence.follow_hint_flow: Clicked pass-button → bidding loop continued → game reached playing phase within ~4s → coach-bubble updated to play-phase text 'Le pli est perdu : fournis au plus bas (9♣).' with 9♣ visibly highlighted (pulsing gold card).
evidence.regression_solo_game: play-solo-card → match-type-short → /game/g_a5a9b87386ec loaded normally; polled coach-bubble every 1s for 8s → NEVER appeared. state.coach_mode=false path confirmed.
evidence.phrases_verified: 'passe' (pass_high), 'Contre' (contre), 'atouts', 'À toi de jouer !' (turn label). All in French and grammatically clean.
evidence.console_health: No pageerror aside from the harmless HTMLAudioElement autoplay warning ('play() failed because the user didn\'t interact with the document first.') — unrelated to coach logic. The 8x '[Reanimated] Selected easing is not currently supported on web' are the expected HandFan easing web-fallback (documented in iteration_14).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reliable path to test the tutorial coach without going through lesson 1..14: (1) login tester1@belote.tn via UI or /api/auth/login for a JWT; (2) POST /api/tutorial/game with Bearer to create a coach_mode=true game; (3) navigate the browser directly to /game/{game_id}. On session A the human seat may open with pass_high (own hand weak vs bot's 90 open); on session B it may open with Contre (fort dans leur atout). To observe more benchmark messages (bid_90..130, support10/20, pass_prudence, pass_weak) repeat the create-game call — dealing is randomised so different reason codes will surface. All FR strings live in /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx L125-135 (mirrors in AR L386-396, EN L646-656).
